sources.label: Morphe patches for popular Dutch applications, unlocking ad-free and tracking fr
sources.author: Dutch applications
patch_list: Disables OSB, Comscore, Sentry and optional Facebook/Firebase measurement, tracking identifiers and queued telemetry. Includes Hide ads. Keeps manual privacy choices and functional account, guide and messaging paths.
Removes ad placements, their reserved space and explicitly branded promotions. Stops ad-only configuration requests and native ad startup/loading while preserving guide and editorial content.
Skips automatic privacy-consent screens after disabling ads and tracking. Records no consent choice and preserves manual cookie settings and existing choices.
